name: Duel
description: Locks an adjacent enemy into single combat for %duration% turns. Neither unit may act, and each is forced to attack the other at the end of its turn.
details: While the duel runs, each combatant takes %duel_vulnerability:pct%% more damage from the other - the exchange is settled roughly twice as fast.
The survivor permanently gains %duel_bonus% to every attribute and heals %duel_heal:pct%% of its maximum health.
That reward is multiplied by %win_multiplier% if the loser was more than a basic unit.
Separating the duellists ends it early, with no reward for either.

upgrade.summary: Lasts %duration% turns, the enemy takes %duel_vulnerability_upgraded:pct%% more damage from this unit, and a win refreshes the cooldown.
details: While the duel runs, each combatant already takes %duel_vulnerability:pct%% more damage from the other - upgraded, that rises to %duel_vulnerability_upgraded:pct%% for the damage this unit deals to the enemy. What this unit takes back stays at %duel_vulnerability:pct%%.
The survivor permanently gains %duel_bonus% to every attribute and heals %duel_heal:pct%% of its maximum health.
That reward is multiplied by %win_multiplier% if the loser was more than a basic unit.
Winning also refreshes this ability outright, so a duel won is a duel that can be started again at once.
Separating the duellists ends it early, with no reward and no refresh for either.
